title: Timed canonizer run correspondence
statement: Let $c$ be an effective machine code, let $b$, $\alpha$, and $x$ be finite Boolean strings, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. After $4|b|+3|\alpha|+8+t$ steps, the timed canonizer started on $\langle\langle b,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$ is in the buffered second-phase configuration formed from the canonizer's configuration after $t$ steps on $\alpha$, together with some Boolean tag, input-head position $4|b|+2|\alpha|+7$, buffer tapes containing $b$, and their heads at position $|b|$.
replaced:
Let $c$ be an effective machine code, and let $b$, $\alpha$, and $x$ be finite Boolean
strings. For every $t\in\mathbb{N}$, there is a Boolean tag $\varepsilon$ such that
after $4|b|+3|\alpha|+8+t$ steps on $\langle\langle b,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$, the timed
canonizer's configuration equals the buffered second-phase configuration formed from the
canonizer's configuration after $t$ steps on $\alpha$, tag $\varepsilon$, input-head
position $4|b|+2|\alpha|+7$, copies of the buffer tape holding $b$, and corresponding
heads at $|b|$.
